title: Big bands visiting Tuskegee and Hinton meeting Wilson's mother
summary: Wilson says a nightclub owner brought Ellington and Cab Calloway's bands to Tuskegee, where his mother met many musician friends.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Uh huh. I have some recollections of meeting your mother when I was with Cab Calloway's band in the early days. We were playing there during the time your folks were in Tuskegee.

Well, that very well could have been -- because during the second world war, there was a man named [Bulls] who had a nightclub off campus there at Tuskegee, and he brought many of the big bands who were traveling, who would play there in Tuskegee. I know that Duke Ellington played there, and Cab -- and that's when you probably met my mother.
Because I know that she got to meet a lot of the musicians.
Because so many of the guys in the band were old friends of mine, and when they went to Tuskegee, they met my mother there.
